events.name: Bash
events.head: Check time, snapshots, log line, job status
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; date; ls workshop-plan/pipeline/snapshots/; grep -n "PIPELINE WEEKLY SNAPSHOT" workshop-plan/coord/LOG.md | tail -3; launchctl list | grep pipeline-weekly; grep -A8 ProgramArguments workshop-plan/ops/com.tantra.pipeline-weekly.plist

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find snapshot code in dash.py
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan/pipeline; grep -n "def snapshot\|def cmd_snapshot\|snapshot" dash.py | head -30; tail -5 weekly.log 2>/dev/null

events.text: Before 09:00 IST now (03:28), so the scheduled run hasn't fired. I'll make the LOG line idempotent per day so kickstarting now and the 09:00 run don't double-log, then kickstart.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Kickstart weekly job and wait for snapshot
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/com.tantra.pipeline-weekly; echo rc=$?; for i in $(seq 1 40); do [ -f workshop-plan/pipeline/snapshots/2026-10-12.json ] && break; sleep 3; done; ls workshop-plan/pipeline/snapshots/; tail -8 workshop-plan/pipeline/weekly.log; grep -c "^2026-10-12 .*PIPELINE WEEKLY SNAPSHOT" workshop-plan/coord/LOG.md

events.text: Found the cause: the snapshot is dated in UTC, so the Monday 09:00 IST run files itself as Sunday (2026-10-11). Also PR lookups fail under launchd. Checking both.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find now() and gh usage
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan/pipeline; grep -n '"now"\|def refresh_prs\|subprocess\|"gh"\|gh api' dash.py | head; grep -n "EnvironmentVariables\|PATH" ../ops/com.tantra.pipeline-weekly.plist; which gh

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect refresh_prs and test under clean env
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan/pipeline; sed -n 51,70p dash.py; grep -n "now=\|\"now\":\|now =" dash.py | head -5; env -i HOME=$HOME /usr/bin/python3 dash.py prs 2>&1 | tail -2; /Users/adithyamurali/.config/tantra/agent-bin/gh api repos/Usetantra/tantra-backend-v2/pulls/160 --jq .state 2>&1 | head -2
